medical_doctor.qualification: MBChB — Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery
medical_doctor.application_tips: Medicine is the most competitive programme in SA — apply to at least 3 universities and do so early. Register for the National Benchmark Test (NBT) as soon as registration opens. Your Grade 11 results matter because universities use them for conditional offers before matric results are released.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L6, Physical Sciences L6, Life Sciences L6
universities.notes: Top-ranked medical school in Africa. NBT required. Apply extremely early.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L6, Physical Sciences L6, Life Sciences L6
universities.notes: Strong hospital network in Johannesburg. NBT required.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L6, Physical Sciences L5, Life Sciences L5
universities.notes: One of the largest medical schools in SA with excellent clinical training.

universities.name: Stellenbosch University
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L6, Physical Sciences L6, Life Sciences L6
universities.notes: World-class faculty. English and Afrikaans instruction available.

universities.name: University of KwaZulu-Natal
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L5, Physical Sciences L5, Life Sciences L5
universities.notes: Best option for learners from KZN and Eastern regions.

nurse.application_tips: Apply for provincial Department of Health bursaries the moment they open — they are specifically designed for nursing students and most include a job guarantee after graduation. After qualifying, SANC (South African Nursing Council) registration is compulsory before you can practise.
bursaries: Department of Health Provincial Bursaries (highly recommended)

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.required_subjects: Life Sciences L5, Mathematics or Maths Literacy L3
universities.notes: Top nursing faculty in SA with excellent hospital training facilities.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Good option for Gauteng learners with strong clinical placement programme.

universities.name: University of KwaZulu-Natal
universities.notes: Strong community and clinical nursing focus.

universities.name: University of the Western Cape
universities.notes: Community health nursing specialisation available.

universities.name: University of Limpopo
universities.notes: Ideal for learners from Limpopo and northern regions.

pharmacist.application_tips: After your BPharm and internship year, you must register with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) before you can dispense any medication. Clicks, Dis-Chem and Netcare all offer bursaries that include guaranteed employment after graduation — apply for these in Grade 11.

universities.name: University of the Western Cape
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L5, Physical Sciences L5, Life Sciences L5
universities.notes: Top pharmacy school in South Africa with excellent industry links.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L5, Physical Sciences L5, Life Sciences L4
universities.notes: Strong BPharm programme in Gauteng with good retail and clinical placements.

universities.name: North-West University
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L5, Physical Sciences L4, Life Sciences L4
universities.notes: Strong pharmaceutical sciences research department.

universities.name: Nelson Mandela University
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L5, Physical Sciences L5, Life Sciences L4
universities.notes: Good option for Eastern Cape and southern region learners.

universities.name: University of Limpopo
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L5, Physical Sciences L5, Life Sciences L5
universities.notes: Best option for northern region learners entering pharmacy.

psychologist.qualification: BA Psychology → Honours → MA/MClinPsych (minimum to register as psychologist)
psychologist.application_tips: A Masters degree is the minimum requirement to register with the HPCSA as a practising psychologist. Industrial Psychology (working in companies) is a shorter route that only requires Honours level. Plan your full academic journey from the start — this is a long but deeply rewarding path.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Top psychology research and clinical training in Africa.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Strong clinical and neuropsychology programmes.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Large faculty with industrial and educational psychology specialisations.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Good access pathway for Gauteng learners. Industrial psychology is a popular route.

universities.name: University of the Western Cape
universities.notes: Community and social psychology focus.

electrical_engineer.application_tips: Register with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) after graduation — it is essential for professional practice and significantly increases your earning potential. South Africa urgently needs electrical engineers for the energy sector.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Top-ranked engineering school in Africa.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Strong Eskom and telecommunications industry links.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Excellent industry ties with major energy and mining companies.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Strong industry connections across Gauteng. Good BEng pathway.

universities.name: Tshwane University of Technology
universities.notes: National Diploma pathway available for students building toward the degree.

civil_engineer.application_tips: SANRAL, the Department of Public Works and major construction firms actively recruit and bursary civil engineering students. Apply for company bursaries before Grade 12 exams — many open as early as March. ECSA registration after graduation is compulsory for professional practice.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Consistently Africa's top civil engineering programme.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Strong infrastructure and structural engineering focus.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Large civil engineering department with extensive research facilities.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Good access pathway with strong Gauteng construction sector links.

universities.name: Tshwane University of Technology
universities.notes: Diploma in Civil Engineering — a practical entry route.

mechanical_engineer.application_tips: Mechanical Engineering is the broadest engineering discipline — it opens doors in manufacturing, automotive, energy and aerospace. ECSA registration after graduation unlocks full professional status and significantly higher salaries. South Africa's mining and manufacturing sectors have high demand.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Top mechanical engineering school with cutting-edge research labs.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Strong automotive and manufacturing industry partnerships.

universities.name: Stellenbosch University
universities.notes: Research-intensive programme with world-class facilities.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Good industry-connected programme in Gauteng with solid ECSA outcomes.

universities.name: Tshwane University of Technology
universities.notes: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering pathway available.

urban_planner.application_tips: South Africa has a critical need for urban planners to address township development, housing backlogs and spatial inequality. SACPLAN (South African Council for Planners) registration is required for professional practice. Municipality bursaries are widely available.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Top planning school in Africa with strong urban development focus.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Strong Johannesburg and township spatial planning programmes.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: One of the largest planning schools in SA.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Practical urban planning programme with strong municipal sector links.

universities.name: University of KwaZulu-Natal
universities.notes: Coastal and rural planning specialisations available.

software_engineer.qualification: BSc Computer Science or BSc Software Engineering
software_engineer.application_tips: Start building personal projects now — a GitHub portfolio of apps you have built is worth more than your marks to most tech employers. Mathematics is the only non-negotiable subject. The demand for software engineers in SA and globally is consistently higher than supply.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Top computer science department in Africa.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Strong fintech and Johannesburg tech industry connections.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Large CS faculty with many specialisations including AI and cybersecurity.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Good access pathway. Strong Gauteng tech industry placement record.

universities.name: UNISA
universities.notes: Flexible distance learning — study while building your portfolio.

data_scientist.qualification: BSc Data Science, BSc Statistics, or BSc Computer Science
data_scientist.application_tips: Learn Python and SQL while still at school — free resources on YouTube and freeCodeCamp are excellent. Data Science is the most in-demand career globally right now. A strong Mathematics foundation is essential. Most data science roles value practical portfolio projects above formal qualifications alone.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Offers dedicated BSc Data Science programme — one of very few in SA.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Strong statistics and applied mathematics pathway into data science.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: BCom Informatics and BSc Statistics both lead to data science careers.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Applied Data Science modules available. Strong business analytics focus.

universities.name: UNISA
universities.notes: Flexible distance learning BSc — good for self-motivated learners.

it_network_admin.qualification: BSc Information Technology or Diploma in IT
it_network_admin.application_tips: Industry certifications add enormous value alongside your degree. While studying, work toward CompTIA A+, then Network+, then Cisco CCNA. Cybersecurity is the fastest-growing and highest-paying IT specialisation right now — consider it as your focus area.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Strong BSc IT and Computer Science options available.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Practical IT programme with strong Gauteng corporate sector placements.

universities.name: Cape Peninsula University of Technology
universities.notes: Industry-aligned IT diploma with strong hands-on technical training.

universities.name: Tshwane University of Technology
universities.notes: National Diploma in IT widely available. Good for Pretoria-based learners.

universities.name: UNISA
universities.notes: Study at your own pace. Ideal for working students building experience alongside studies.

game_developer.qualification: BSc Computer Science or Diploma in Game Development
game_developer.application_tips: Download Unity or Godot (both free) and start building small games today. A portfolio of real games you have built will get you into any university or company faster than grades alone. The South African gaming industry is small but growing — many SA developers work for international studios remotely.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Game design and development modules offered within BSc IT. Active game dev community on campus.

universities.name: Cape Peninsula University of Technology
universities.notes: Multimedia and game development pathway through IT diploma.

universities.name: Vega School (IIE)
universities.notes: Creative and technical game design approach. Portfolio-based entry.

universities.name: AFDA
universities.notes: Animation and digital arts focus. Audition or portfolio required.

universities.name: UNISA
universities.notes: BSc Computing via distance learning — good for self-taught developers.

chartered_accountant.qualification: BCom Accounting → CTA → SAICA Board Exams → 3 years Articles
chartered_accountant.duration: 7 to 8 years total (degree + articles + board exams)
chartered_accountant.application_tips: The SAICA Thuthuka Bursary is specifically designed for Black African and Coloured students wanting to become CAs — it covers full tuition and living costs. Apply in Grade 11. The CA(SA) designation is one of the most respected qualifications on the African continent and opens doors globally.
bursaries: SAICA Thuthuka Bursary (priority — covers full costs)

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Best SAICA board exam pass rates in SA. Strong Big 4 firm recruitment.

universities.name: Stellenbosch University
universities.notes: Top accounting research university. Strong CA(SA) pipeline.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Strong Big 4 recruitment pipeline in Johannesburg.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Large accounting faculty. Good Thuthuka bursary intake.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Strong access pathway with Thuthuka programme. Well-regarded BCom Accounting.

financial_analyst.qualification: BCom Finance or BCom Investment Management
financial_analyst.duration: 3 years (+ CFA certification recommended after graduation)
financial_analyst.application_tips: The CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) is the global gold standard for investment professionals — start studying for it after your degree. Mathematics is essential. Strong Excel and financial modelling skills are what employers test in interviews, so start practising these early.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Top finance faculty in Africa. Strong JSE and asset management connections.

universities.name: Stellenbosch University
universities.notes: Investment management specialisation available. Strong industry reputation.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Located near the JSE in Johannesburg — strong industry access.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Large BCom Finance faculty with investment management option.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Good access programme with solid Johannesburg financial sector links.

entrepreneur.qualification: BCom Entrepreneurship or BCom Business Management
entrepreneur.application_tips: Start a small business now — even selling things at school teaches you more than any textbook. A degree gives you business knowledge and credibility, but your hustle and execution are what will actually make you successful. Look into the NYDA (National Youth Development Agency) for startup funding after school.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Best entrepreneurship ecosystem in Africa. Home to LaunchLab incubator.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Good BCom Entrepreneurship with startup support programmes.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Strong Entrepreneurship Development Centre on campus.

universities.name: North-West University
universities.notes: Solid BCom Entrepreneurship with good SME support network.

universities.name: UNISA
universities.notes: Study while running your business. Highly flexible.

marketing_manager.qualification: BCom Marketing or BA Communication Science
marketing_manager.application_tips: Build your personal brand on social media now. Marketers who can show real results — a following they built, campaigns they ran, content they created — get hired before people with degrees but no experience. Learn Google Ads, Meta Business Manager and basic SEO for free on YouTube.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Top business and communication school. Strong advertising industry links.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Strong BCom Marketing with solid industry placements.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: BCom Marketing with strong Gauteng advertising and media connections.

universities.name: Vega School (IIE)
universities.notes: Brand communication and marketing focus. Portfolio-based entry.

universities.name: AAA School of Advertising
universities.notes: Industry-focused advertising school with strong agency placement record.

graphic_designer.qualification: BA Graphic Design or Diploma in Graphic Design
graphic_designer.application_tips: Build a portfolio of your best creative work now — even designs made on free tools like Canva count. Universities and employers in this field care more about your creativity and eye for design than your APS score. Freelancing is also a legitimate full career path with unlimited earning potential.

universities.name: Cape Peninsula University of Technology
universities.notes: Portfolio interview required. Strong digital design and visual communication focus.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: BA Visual Communication — strong industry links in Johannesburg.

universities.name: Tshwane University of Technology
universities.notes: Diploma in Graphic Design with strong digital and print focus.

universities.name: Vega School (IIE)
universities.notes: Private institution — excellent creative culture and industry exposure.

universities.name: Red and Yellow Creative School
universities.notes: Industry-leading creative school in Cape Town. Portfolio entry.

journalist.qualification: BA Journalism or BA Media Studies
journalist.application_tips: Start writing now. Start a blog, contribute to your school newspaper, post commentary on current events. Journalism employers look at your portfolio of published work. Strong English, curiosity and the courage to ask hard questions are your most valuable tools.
bursaries: Media Development and Diversity Agency (MDDA) Bursaries

universities.name: Rhodes University
universities.notes: Best journalism school in Africa. Strong investigative reporting culture.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Strong print, broadcast and digital journalism programmes.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: BA Communication with journalism focus. Good Gauteng media sector connections.

universities.name: University of KwaZulu-Natal
universities.notes: Media studies and journalism. Good for KZN and Eastern region learners.

universities.name: Cape Peninsula University of Technology
universities.notes: Practical diploma with broadcast and digital focus. Strong industry exposure.

architect.application_tips: Start sketching and building models now — a strong visual portfolio is required for admission at most schools. EGD (Engineering Graphics and Design) and Visual Arts at school are excellent preparation. SACAP (South African Council for the Architectural Profession) registration is required to practise professionally.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Best architecture school in Africa. Portfolio review required. Highly competitive.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Strong urban design and Johannesburg inner-city focus.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Large school of the built environment with strong studio culture.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Architecture and Construction Management options available.

universities.name: Nelson Mandela University
universities.notes: Good option for Eastern Cape learners. Practical studio-focused programme.

environmental_scientist.qualification: BSc Environmental Science or BSc Environmental Management
environmental_scientist.application_tips: South Africa is one of the world's most biodiverse countries — environmental scientists are urgently needed. The green economy is growing fast and climate change roles are among the most in-demand careers of the coming decade. Geography and Life Sciences at school are excellent foundations.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Top environmental research in Africa. Strong ecology and marine science focus.

universities.name: Stellenbosch University
universities.notes: Excellent conservation and sustainability programmes.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Adjacent to Kruger — strong wildlife and field research focus.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Environmental management programme with urban ecology focus.

universities.name: University of the Free State
universities.notes: Strong semi-arid and agricultural environment focus.

agricultural_scientist.application_tips: South Africa is one of Africa's most important agricultural economies and food security is a national priority. DAFF (Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries) bursaries are widely available and include job placement. Agricultural Sciences or Life Sciences at school gives you the best preparation.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Top agriculture faculty in Africa with cutting-edge research facilities.

universities.name: Stellenbosch University
universities.notes: Strong in viticulture, food science and agribusiness.

universities.name: University of the Free State
universities.notes: Central SA agricultural heartland. Strong crop science programmes.

universities.name: University of Limpopo
universities.required_subjects: Agricultural Sciences L4 or Life Sciences L4
universities.notes: Best option for northern region learners. Tropical and subtropical farming focus.

universities.name: University of Fort Hare
universities.notes: Focus on smallholder and communal farming systems.

biomedical_scientist.qualification: BSc Biomedical Science or BSc Medical Laboratory Science
biomedical_scientist.application_tips: Biomedical Science feeds directly into medical diagnostics, pharmaceutical research and hospital laboratories. HPCSA registration as a Medical Technologist is required for laboratory practice. This career sits at the exciting intersection of science and technology.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L5, Physical Sciences L5, Life Sciences L5
universities.notes: Top biomedical science faculty with world-class laboratory facilities.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L6, Physical Sciences L5, Life Sciences L5
universities.notes: World-class medical research environment and affiliated hospitals.

universities.name: Stellenbosch University
universities.required_subjects: Mathematics L5, Physical Sciences L5, Life Sciences L5
universities.notes: Strong pharmaceutical and biotech research output.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Applied biomedical sciences programme within the Faculty of Health Sciences.

universities.name: University of the Free State
universities.notes: Medical laboratory science pathway available.

teacher.qualification: BEd — Bachelor of Education (4-year professional degree)
teacher.application_tips: The Funza Lushaka Bursary covers your full degree costs AND guarantees you a government teaching post after graduation — it is one of the best deals available to any South African student. Apply for it the same time you apply to university. South Africa urgently needs more teachers, especially in Mathematics, Science and Technology.
bursaries: Funza Lushaka Bursary (covers ALL costs + job guarantee)

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Top BEd programme in SA. Excellent Funza Lushaka placement record.

universities.name: Stellenbosch University
universities.notes: Strong teacher training with excellent school placement networks.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Large education faculty with strong Gauteng school placement programme.

universities.name: University of Limpopo
universities.notes: Ideal for rural and Limpopo learners. Strong community schools focus.

universities.name: UNISA
universities.notes: Part-time BEd — ideal for teaching assistants wanting to qualify while working.

social_worker.application_tips: Social Work is a protected title — you must register with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) before practising. The Department of Social Development actively recruits and offers bursaries specifically for this field. This is one of the most urgently needed professions in South Africa.
bursaries: Department of Social Development Bursaries (widely available)

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Strong government and NGO placement network.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Good community social work programme with Gauteng DSD placements.

universities.name: University of KwaZulu-Natal
universities.notes: Community development and rural social work focus.

universities.name: University of the Western Cape
universities.notes: Long history of community-based social work practice.

universities.name: University of Limpopo
universities.notes: Ideal for rural community-focused practice in the north.

lawyer.application_tips: After your LLB you must complete 2 years of articles of clerkship (for attorneys) or pupillage at the Bar (for advocates) before you can practise. Strong English reading and writing are more important than any specific subject. Critical thinking, confidence and communication skills set great lawyers apart.

universities.name: University of Cape Town
universities.notes: Top-ranked law school in Africa. Strong human rights and commercial law focus.

universities.name: University of the Witwatersrand
universities.notes: Strong commercial law, constitutional law and social justice programmes.

universities.name: University of Pretoria
universities.notes: Large law faculty with many specialisations including mercantile and criminal law.

universities.name: University of Johannesburg
universities.notes: Good access pathway. Strong Johannesburg legal sector placements.

universities.name: University of KwaZulu-Natal
universities.notes: Strong social justice, public law and community legal practice.
